reason: Ordinary names with dots or spaces are plain file names under the cited docstring and must be created, read and listed.
Rejecting a leading-dot or colon name is a reasonable stricter validation choice that the cited docstring does not forbid.

The read check matches the exact compact JSON text "n":3, so it depends on response whitespace rather than on required behaviour.
